annotations.text:
This one works.

Switch the server type, change the authentication method, and the fields underneath change with it.

Run Test connection on Billing-DB, then on Ledger-Core, to see success and a real failure.

Press Connect on either production connection to meet the guard.

The theme chip above the frame flips the whole page to light.

A failure is the most valuable screen in a database tool, so it gets the most design.

Each one says what the server actually returned, what that usually means here, and offers the safe fix as the first button. Trusting a certificate blindly is never the first button.

Below 760px the list rail becomes a picker at the top, labels move above their fields, and the action bar splits into two rows.

This is the width people actually get when the page is opened beside a query editor.

The numbers an implementer needs, and the reason the page will look right in themes nobody here has installed.

Every surface reads a VS Code theme token. The four environment colours are the only literal values in the design.
